documents.title: AI Code of Ethics and Minimum Standards (AI Ethical Considerations and Guidance)
documents.summary: A short university-wide guidance page from the Tarleton State AI Council with role-based quick guidelines (teach, learn, research, work) and links to TAMUS regulations. It sets no ban or default; it expects instructors to state in each syllabus what is allowed, what needs disclosure and what is not permitted, and asks students to cite AI and users to protect data.
documents.stance_why: The page never says AI is banned or allowed by default for coursework. It tells instructors to "Clearly state expectations for AI use in your course syllabus, including what is allowed, what requires disclosure, and what is not permitted", handing the decision to each instructor, so the stance is delegates.
